The Library · Sacred Texts

Enūma eliš

Enūma Eliš

The Babylonian creation epic in seven tablets: Apsû’s fall, Tiamat’s war, and Marduk’s ordering of heaven and earth. The oldest creation narrative in the library.

Anonymous (Babylonian) c. 12th century BC (Seven Tablets recension)
7 Sections
5 Temples named

English (King, 1902) — L. W. King, The Seven Tablets of Creation (1902). License: Public domain. Source.
